## Host project checks (this run)

For the checks below, and only for them, this section overrides the "Environment" interpreter rule and the legacy `tests` command-string format above: run each command verbatim with Bash from the repository root (it changes into its own context directory; your working and editing root stays the repository root). Do not alter argv, cwd, interpreter or environment, and do not install dependencies. `tests` holds exactly one {check_id, status, exit_code} per check: executed with the exit code you observed (a failure stays a failure), or not_run with null.
